source_refs.note: Exercise 3.4, Question 2: Exercise 3.4, book page 94: Q1-Q15 (integration by partial fractions); answers book pages 301-302

blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi rational function ka integral hai, lekin is dafa denominator \(x^2 + 4x + 3\) factorised shakal mein nahi diya.
Pehla kaam: denominator ko factors mein torna. Factor hone ke baad yeh Case-I ban jayega (do alag linear factors).
Fraction proper hai (upar degree 1, neeche degree 2), is liye division nahi chahiye.
Plan: factorise, partial fractions, roots rakh kar constants, aur aakhir mein \(\ln\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{3x + 5}{x^2 + 4x + 3}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: yeh integral.
Tareeqa: pehle denominator factorise karenge, phir partial fractions (Case-I). Partial fractions ka tareeqa tabhi chalta hai jab denominator factors mein toota hua ho, is liye factorisation hamesha pehla qadam hai.

Denominator ko factorise karein
\[x^2 + 4x + 3 = (x + 1)(x + 3)\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product 3 aur jama 4 ho: woh 1 aur 3 hain. Khud check kijiye: \((x + 1)(x + 3) = x^2 + 3x + x + 3 = x^2 + 4x + 3\).

Partial fractions likhein aur fractions khatam karein
\[\dfrac{3x + 5}{(x + 1)(x + 3)} = \dfrac{A}{x + 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\]
\[3x + 5 = A(x + 3) + B(x + 1) \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Har linear factor ke neeche ek constant. Phir dono sides ko \((x + 1)(x + 3)\) se multiply kiya taa ke fractions khatam ho jayein aur seedhi si identity (1) bache.

(1) mein \(x = -1\) aur \(x = -3\) rakhein
\[x = -1:\ 2 = 2A,\ A = 1\]
\[x = -3:\ -4 = -2B,\ B = 2\]
Kyun: \(x = -1\) par \(B(x + 1)\) zero ho jata hai: \(3(-1) + 5 = 2\) aur \(A(-1 + 3) = 2A\). \(x = -3\) par \(A(x + 3)\) zero: \(3(-3) + 5 = -4\) aur \(B(-3 + 1) = -2B\).
Dhyan dein: Roots wohi values hain jo factor ko zero karti hain: \(x + 1 = 0\) se \(x = -1\), plus 1 nahi.

Integral lein
\[\int \dfrac{3x + 5}{x^2 + 4x + 3}\,dx\]
\[= \int \dfrac{dx}{x + 1} + 2\int \dfrac{dx}{x + 3}\]
\[= \ln|x + 1| + 2\ln|x + 3| + c\]
Kyun: \(\int \frac{dx}{x + a} = \ln|x + a| + c\), kyunke \(x + a\) ka derivative 1 hai. Constant 2 bahar aa gaya.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{1}{x + 1} + \dfrac{2}{x + 3} = \dfrac{x + 3 + 2x + 2}{(x + 1)(x + 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{3x + 5}{x^2 + 4x + 3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono partial fractions ko wapas jama karne se asal integrand mil gaya, yani hamare constants bilkul sahi hain.

blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answers (page 301) mein Exercise 3.4 ke jawab ghalat heading "Exercise 3.6" ke neeche chhape hain. Is sawal ka jawab us block ka item (ii) hai: \(\ln|x + 1| + 2\ln|x + 3| + c\). Yeh jawab sahi hai. Jis block par "Exercise 3.4" likha hai (page 301) woh kisi aur exercise ke jawab hain, is liye wahan se milane ki koshish na karein.
